title: Sav passes 100,000 users and raises $3.5mln to scale AI-native financial platform
summary: GCC-based fintech extends from cards into investing, precious metals and credit
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Purvi Munot, Co-Founder and CEO of Sav, and Mithil Ajmera, Co-Founder and COO of Sav. Image Courtesy: Sav

GCC-based fintech extends from cards into investing, precious metals and credit

Press Release

  • Pre-Series A led by Phoenix Venture Partners takes total funding to USD 5.5Mn

Dubai, UAE – Sav, the GCC-based financial technology platform, has raised US$3.5 million in Pre-Series A funding to scale its AI-native platform and deepen its capabilities across artificial intelligence, open finance and wealth products.

The latest round was led by Phoenix Venture Partners alongside participation from 394H Capital, Vestalia Investments, Majlis Investment Management, 500 Sanabil and KAUST Innovation Ventures, alongside leading family offices and angels. The latest financing brings Sav’s cumulative funding to US$5.5 million.      

Expatriates are among the world’s largest underserved financial populations. Around 35 million in the GCC alone hold accounts, savings and investments spread across several countries, institutions and currencies, with no single view of any of it. Sav builds that view and then acts on it: its AI reads across a customer’s connected financial accounts, surfaces personalized insights and recommends the next best financial action across saving, spending, investing and credit.     

Starting with cards, Sav has expanded into money intelligence, public-market investing and fractional gold & silver, while building its next generation of credit products; progressively creating a broader platform for consumers to manage and build diversified wealth.

The new capital will fund three priorities over the next 12 months: launching Sav’s credit product, scaling the business across the GCC, and building connectivity to financial accounts globally.

Purvi Munot, Co-Founder and CEO of Sav, said, “The way people build wealth has changed significantly. Financial lives are more distributed across geographies, institutions and asset classes, while the underlying experience of managing that money remains fragmented. Consumers are increasingly expected to make complex decisions across spending, investing, diversification and credit without a complete view of how those decisions interact. We see open finance and AI as an opportunity to change that.”     

"Purvi and Mithil are exactly the type of founders we seek to back: ambitious, visionary, and relentlessly execution-focused," said Steve Khayat, Founder and CEO of Phoenix Venture Partners.

The company has grown to more than 100,000 users across its markets and has recently entered strategic partnerships with Visa, Emirates Gold among others, supporting the continued expansion of its payments and financial services proposition. Sav today has subsidiaries across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.

Mithil Ajmera, Co-Founder and COO of Sav, added “Over the last decade, fintech has enabled rapid digitization of personal financial products. The next phase will be defined by platforms that connect them intelligently, securely and at scale. We believe that success in this sector will be built on trust, intelligence and disciplined execution. Over the past few years, we have established those foundations; this round accelerates our ambition to build Sav into a global financial institution for the next generation of consumers.”

Sav is also backed by a broader investor base spanning venture capital, sovereign-backed investment platforms, family offices and angel investors.

About Sav:

Sav is a GCC-based regulated consumer fintech building the financial operating system for global expats. Founded in 2022 by Purvi Munot and Mithil Ajmera, Sav brings a client’s complete financial life - accounts, cards, savings, and investments across institutions, onto a single intelligent platform that identifies opportunity and acts on it automatically. A UAE Future100 company backed by the startup programs of Google, Amazon, and NVIDIA, Sav Technologies Limited is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA).
